# Deep Work

Notes on a book about focused work and why it matters.

## Core idea

The ability to concentrate without distraction on a cognitively demanding task is becoming rare and increasingly valuable. Shallow work is logistical, easy to replicate, and does not create much value.

## Rules

Rule one is to work deeply: schedule fixed blocks of focus time and protect them. Rule two is to embrace boredom so the mind can tolerate a lack of stimulation. Rule three is to quit social media unless the benefit clearly outweighs the cost. Rule four is to drain the shallows by scheduling every minute of the day.

## Quotes

Clarity about what matters provides clarity about what does not.
